FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 342
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Susan DuBose
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 342 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board
of Education and certain local boards of education by requiring the adoption and
implementation of released time policies, which is permissive under current law.
